notes.title: Play The Quarry this Halloween, now with additional '50s outfits
notes.notes:
If you're looking to scare yourself silly this Halloween season, you'll find plenty of thrills and chills in The Quarry. Now's the perfect time to visit the Hackett's Quarry sleepaway camp… just don't count on making it back alive.

For those who haven't yet experienced The Quarry, the prologue chapter is the perfect place to preview the horror that awaits—which you can play for free with The Quarry Official Trial Version.

[b]'50s Throwback Character Outfits[/b]
For those who own The Quarry, we're also introducing a new pack of cosmetic outfits that give the cast a set of Baby Boomer-style duds. With the new '50s Throwback Character Outfits pack, all the Hackett's Quarry counselors will be sporting old-school attire, looking equal parts dapper and chic.

Best of all, you can claim the '50s Throwback Character Outfits free for a limited time until 10:00 AM PT on November 1, 2022!* Make sure to snap up those vintage threads for free while you can, and get a good look at those retro fabrics and silk shirts before they're inevitably splattered with blood.

[b]The Quarry Red Band Trailer[/b]
Right in time for Halloween, horror fans will get a kick out of the fresh red-band-style trailer for The Quarry, which contains buckets of blood and shocking dismemberments that'd be right at home in a grindhouse gorefest lineup. If you're averse to bloody violence or story spoilers, it'd be best if you look away now.

[previewyoutube=pucGpX7O8PQ;full][/previewyoutube]

As October 31 approaches, be sure to follow @2K on Twitter and @VisitTheQuarry on Instagram and TikTok so you don't miss out.

[b]Save 40% off The Quarry for a limited time**[/b]
If you're ready to brave The Quarry, now's the perfect time! Save 40%** on The Quarry Standard Edition and Deluxe Edition from now until November 4 at 10:00 AM PT. You won't believe what you'll become.

notes.title: Quality-of-life additions to The Quarry! August 9 Update
notes.notes:
Today's update to The Quarry features various quality-of-life improvements, including a new difficulty setting for Quick Time Events and added language options for subtitles!

If you fancy yourself a QTE expert who can dodge danger at every turn, test your limits using the new 'Min Timer' setting. With the added challenge of this setting, each QTE will be a blink-and-you'll-miss-it race against the clock; don't be surprised if even the slightest hesitation results in gruesome death when things get hectic.

That being said, there are a multitude of outcomes you can only experience by failing QTEs, so you're likely to see scenes you might never have otherwise—don't be afraid to fail! The Min Timer setting can only be used when playing in single-player. To enable it, go to the Main Menu, then Settings, then Accessibility and set QTE Speed to 'Min Timer.'

Another quality-of-life choice included in this update is the ability to pair English voiceovers with region-specific language subtitles. To activate this, go to the Main Menu, then Settings, then Audio and toggle 'Enable English Dialogue.'

Here's a complete list of the changes included with this update:
●      Added 'Min Timer' option for increased difficulty during QTEs
●      Added 'Enable English Dialogue' to pair with region-specific subtitles
●      General bug fixes and polish

notes.title: The Quarry Free Trial now available, compatible with Wolf Pack multiplayer!
notes.notes:
If you haven't yet experienced The Quarry for yourself, you can get a taste of the horror that awaits with the new Free Trial on Steam, available now! Simply click "Play Game" on “Free to Play” version on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1577120/The_Quarry/]The Quarry Steam Store page[/url] to get access to the full Prologue chapter plus the Wolf Pack multiplayer mode.

Introduced in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1577120/view/3335493590068003897]July 7 update for The Quarry[/url], Wolf Pack is an invite-only online multiplayer mode supporting up to eight players total. One host player can invite up to seven friends to help shape their run, as everyone votes together on key decisions. If you have a friend who owns a full version of The Quarry on Steam, they'll be able to invite you to their Wolf Pack even if you only own the Free Trial!

We hope you enjoy all the gratis scares included in The Quarry Free Trial. Remember, what doesn't kill you will make you stronger.

notes.title: New Content for The Quarry! July 7 Update
notes.notes:
Ready to revisit the summertime horrors of The Quarry with your friends and outfit the playable counselors in a retro style? Today's update to The Quarry includes the new online multiplayer mode called Wolf Pack, which lets a host player invite up to seven friends with access to the game so the whole group can vote on key decisions. How will your Wolf Pack fare when confronted with danger in The Quarry?

'80s Throwback Character Outfits DLC are also now available for owners of the Deluxe Edition of The Quarry, and are available for separate purchase. Now your counselors' attire can capture the tubular 'tude of the 1980s, letting you look totally rad as you run for your life.

Here's a complete list of the changes included with this update:
[list]
[*] Added the new online multiplayer mode, “Wolf Pack”, an invite-only mode where the host can invite up to seven friends with access to the game to vote on key decisions to create a story shaped by the whole group
[*] '80s Throwback Character Outfits DLC now available for owners of the Deluxe Edition of The Quarry, and are available for separate purchase
[*] Fixes for "Hard Pass" and "Should've Gone to the Motel" Achievements
[*] Renamed Streamer Mode to Alternate Music
[*] Adjustments to Death Rewind
[*] General bug fixes and polish
[/list]

notes.title: The Quarry is available now!
notes.notes:
Rise and shine, campers! Your first day at Camp Hackett starts now! The Quarry is finally here, so we whipped up a little release trailer to prep you for a terrifying summer camp experience you'll never forget. 

[previewyoutube=9pm4sA1G5qA;full][/previewyoutube]

The fate of all nine teenage camp counselors are in your hands. Can you save them from certain death? Or will you throw them directly into danger? It's up to you. Every decision shapes your unique story from a tangled web of possibilities. Any character can be the star of the show—or die before daylight comes.

How will your story unfold?

notes.title: Watch The Quarry's Prologue
notes.notes:
In this new gameplay trailer, get a sneak peek of the opening chapter to The Quarry, the new cinematic horror story from 2K and Supermassive Games.

[previewyoutube=8f7bk8tcVV0;full][/previewyoutube]

During the prologue of The Quarry, teenage camp counselors Laura (Siobhan Williams) and her boyfriend Max (Skyler Gisondo) drive to Hackett’s Quarry Summer Camp one night earlier than they were scheduled to arrive. Things do not go as planned.

Find out how the rest of this teen horror story unfolds based on your decisions when The Quarry launches this summer on June 10, 2022.
